title: 2,300 sq.ft Showroom for Sale · Maple Trade Centre, Thaltej
address: Maple Trade Centre, Surdhara Circle, Maple Trade Centre Road, Thaltej, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380052
description: Showroom in Maple Trade Centre, Thaltej, with 2,300 sq.ft super built up and 1,300 sq.ft carpet and a 22 ft frontage.

Set in a G+13 building with 2 lifts and 23 units per floor, around 5 to 10 years old. Priced at ₹20,000 per sq.ft on super built up, which works out to about ₹4.6 Cr. Well suited to Cafe, Restaurant, Clothing, Garments, Designer and Salon.
